policy: Every entry has a local publishable media path, an exact source URL, and a truthful credit. The selector chooses the least-used entry and then the longest-unseen entry; recency is a diversity preference, never an eligibility ban, so a valid campaign cannot deadlock when the finite library is exhausted. Every entry also carries an "alt" accessibility description (RULINGS-SOCIAL.md A3/B2), written ONCE here and reviewed in this file's own PR — a draft's altText[] must copy it verbatim (see scripts/social/select-photo.mjs's output and lib/queue-schema.mjs's validatePhotoInventoryBinding) rather than retyping it per post, so attribution and description cannot drift apart.
